subject: Iceland
note: Hand-curated research for a Geographica episode about Iceland. Claims are cited to a pinned Wikipedia revision (trusted_secondary). The Mid-Atlantic Ridge is not drawn; the episode shows the country and the two continents on either side.

claims.text: Iceland is a Nordic island country between the Arctic Ocean and the North Atlantic Ocean, located on the Mid-Atlantic Ridge between Europe and North America.
Geologically, the island includes parts of both continental plates.
Iceland is Europe’s westernmost and most sparsely populated country.
Iceland is closer to continental Europe than to mainland North America, although it is closest to Greenland, an island of North America.
Its roughly 395,000 residents include about 35% living in the capital Reykjavík.
